passages.heading: Alternate Nostril Breathing

passages.heading: Energizing Fire Breath
passages.text: Rapid diaphragmatic pumping. Generate heat, clear stagnation, awaken vitality. Not for hypertension.

passages.heading: Skull Shining Breath
passages.text: Forceful exhalations, passive inhalations. Cleanse frontal brain, stimulate digestion, brighten awareness.

passages.heading: Tongue Roll Cooling
passages.text: Inhale through rolled tongue. Cool the system, reduce pitta, calm anger. Summer essential.
